acceptance_test: At least 14 of 16 cuts on a detected onset or beat with no cut moved more than 8 frames from v7; owner review of the contact sheets.
candidate_rule:
problem: Some word cuts do not land on a hit when a song has no onset near the approved cut.
implementation: Snap to the strongest onset or tracked beat within +-0.25 s, keep >= 0.5 s between cuts, and show the owner a frame-numbered comparison against the approved timing before rendering.
use_when: Re-cutting an approved motion piece to new music.
avoid_when: The approved timing itself was the brief (exact copy of a reference).
cause_hypothesis: [implementation; unvalidated] A +-0.18 s window around v7's cuts is too narrow for slow or sparse songs (corrido, 78 BPM trap); a beat-grid snap or a wider window with an owner-approved limit would put every word on a hit without visibly changing the choreography.
problem_evidence: 7 of 16 cuts found no onset above the threshold and kept v7's time: song 1 Storage; song 2 Unlimited; song 3 Unlimited, Free* and headline (the corrido is in its decay at 4.37 s; its final hits are 5.22/5.60 s, after the end card is up).
